channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
item.description: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Presentation: How To Run on Three Clouds at Once, and When Not To
item.description: Ross McFarlane and Kevin Holditch discuss Form3's evolution from a single-cloud setup to a triple active multi-cloud architecture. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
item.description: Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs. Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app. (1 source: githubblog)
